text: Shelf ported to the template: banded spines with gilt caps and ribs, planks with plaque pills, dot legend, continue cards, book panel and phone dock; the Orientation moves to the Learning Path as a card for someone new; the My Notes card becomes a Continue-reading bookmark or a Passage of the day (curated list, BSB text); the Reader now saves the reading place and a chapter excerpt; the intro paragraph stays on a phone
